BOARD OBSERVER AGREEMENT

This Board Observer Agreement is entered into as of March 16, 2026 between Fennel Robotics, Inc. (the "Company") and Orchard Seed Fund LLC (the "Investor").

1. Relationship. The Company values the Investor's advice and will keep the Investor informed about the business.

2. Meetings. The Investor's representative is welcome at the Company's offices.

3. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of California.
